AT0083.title: OT and IoT Protocol Exploitation Tools
AT0083.description: A collection of scanning and exploitation tools targeting operational technology (OT) and IoT device protocols, covering industrial control, connected vehicles, medical IoT, and edge-device scenarios. Attackers exploit flaws or misconfigurations in ICS protocols such as Modbus, OPC-UA, Profinet, DNP3, and IEC 61850, in-vehicle bus protocols such as CAN and V2X, and IoT protocols such as MQTT, CoAP, and BLE to perform unauthorized access, command injection, sensor-data forgery, PLC/RTU control tampering, medical-device control, and connected-vehicle message spoofing. These tools focus on the protocol-layer attack surface of OT and IoT environments, and are distinct from vulnerability exploitation tools for IT networks and general applications (AT0054). In-vehicle protocol attacks form an upstream/downstream division of labor with connected-vehicle OTA and interface testing tools (AT0097).
keywords: OT and IoT Protocol Exploitation Tools
